title: 让 Repo Harness 稳定、快速地操作物理 iPhone
summary: 保留为唯一的物理 iPhone 自动化用户需求。已完成的 Provider 边界、CoreDevice、agent-device、跨引擎互斥和证据分层继续保留；JD 搜索、热路径延迟和剩余验证将在新运行时与需求/Work 架构切换后重新生成执行 Work。当前没有可调度旧 Task。
goals: 可靠发现并独占用户选择的物理 iPhone。
在不处理密码、验证码、支付或生物识别的前提下，稳定完成已知 App 的语义操作。
让正常热路径延迟可测量、可优化，并在失败后保留可恢复的 session。
统一 CoreDevice、agent-device 和 signed runner 的能力边界与证据。
nonGoals: 不越狱、不绕过 iOS 安全控制。
不自动处理密码、验证码、生物识别、购买、结算或支付。
不在运行时下载或临时引入未经固定版本的自动化工具。
不在新的控制面架构完成前继续扩展旧 Task/Run 模型。
acceptanceCriteria: 同一物理设备在所有自动化引擎间只有一个资源所有者。
已知语义路径可以在一个有界 session 中执行，并返回有界证据和阶段耗时。
可恢复的 selector/ref/语义失败不会无条件销毁健康 session。
Runner、传输或结果不确定故障会 fail closed 并正确释放或隔离资源。
JD 等真实流程通过 fixture、故障注入和可选实机验证。

tasks.title: Implement bounded iOS session direct execution
tasks.objective: Design and implement a short allowlisted interaction-session execution path with ownership, cancellation, timeout, receipt and durable escalation.
acceptanceCriteria: No concurrent writes to one device or interaction.
Short session actions avoid one durable scheduler job per action.
Long or recoverable work still escalates to Durable execution.
notes: 等待 ISS-20260802-539E7F 与 ISS-20260802-7E1D69 完成运行时和 Work-only 执行模型。旧 Task 不能直接调度，后续从用户验收差距重新生成 Work。

tasks.title: Complete tiered iOS accessibility evidence
tasks.objective: Add selector or ref reuse, settle diff, exact wait, scoped snapshot and full snapshot fallback tiers with bounded redacted evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: Exact waits skip full trees.
Stale refs safely recover.
Snapshot cost is measured by evidence tier.
notes: Automation turn 2: implementing one bounded stale-ref recovery and tiered evidence increment on clean main.

Completed selector-preference increment: stable search/submit selectors override cached refs, eliminating the initial snapshot and stale-ref risk when both are supplied. Focused iOS tests, type, runtime architecture, and MCP compatibility passed. Remaining T2 work: automatic stale-ref retry/recovery and measured tier escalation.

Implemented and committed one-shot classified stale accessibility ref recovery for JD search at af68cee8bce75c870edf9f06cd6b978e34ace57c. Only ref/accessibility errors with stale/expired/missing/not-found semantics refresh one interactive snapshot and retry once; all other errors still failSession and close/fence ownership. Focused tests, type, runtime architecture and MCP compatibility passed. Remaining T2 work: exact-wait failure escalation to scoped/full snapshots and evidence-tier latency benchmarks.

Completed and committed exact-wait evidence escalation at 2d9a55d4d4b006cd4e6841df613e140f4b0ba478. Only classified text/selector wait misses fall back to scoped interactive snapshot, then one full snapshot if scoped evidence is empty. Runner/transport/connection failures remain fail-closed and close/fence the session. Focused iOS tests, TypeScript, runtime architecture, MCP compatibility, and edit-session verification passed. Remaining T2 work is repeatable cold/warm p50/p95 evidence-tier benchmarking and any evidence-backed tuning.
已完成 selector 优先、stale-ref 恢复和 evidence escalation 的代码增量；剩余 benchmark 与调优等待新架构切换后按用户验收重新生成 Work。

tasks.title: Audit and refactor the iOS automation provider boundary
tasks.objective: Perform a whole-subsystem review using the real-device failures from 2026-08-01 as primary evidence. Split the monolithic ios-agent-device integration into provider capability negotiation, command compilation, session/runner lifecycle, semantic snapshots/selectors, App adapters, failure classification, evidence and fallback routing. Fix unsupported-flag emission, shallow-tree false negatives, opaque fill/press failures, over-eager session destruction, idempotent cleanup and CoreDevice fallback. Evaluate the installed and current upstream agent-device sources; patch or fork them only where the defect belongs below the Repo Harness adapter, keeping the integration replaceable and version-pinned.
acceptanceCriteria: A reviewed architecture map identifies each defect's owning layer before implementation.
Repo Harness does not hard-code unsupported agent-device flags or assume one CLI version.
Known App adapters can declare semantic scope/depth and stable selector bundles without requiring full screenshots.
Recoverable action errors preserve a healthy session; transport/runner errors still fail closed.
All new provider decisions and failure classes have fixture, property or fault-injection coverage.
Any agent-device fork or patch is isolated behind a provider adapter, version-pinned, documented and replaceable.
No sensitive-action boundary is weakened and no live-device mutation is required for the offline test suite.
notes: Phase 1 integrated at 85f9604d. Focused iOS tests 28/28, type, runtime architecture, MCP compatibility and a clean full Controller V8 rerun passed before commit. Edit Session EDIT-1785543410038-a9c04b57 later recorded three native checks as failed even though their persisted latest artifacts report ok=true and independent executions passed; treat this as Process/Edit Session bookkeeping evidence, not a source regression. Continue Phase 2 in a fresh bounded edit session; do not alter unrelated tasks/issues dirty files.

Phase 2 adds exact optional dependency agent-device@0.20.2 for the typed read backend. package-lock.json must be included alongside package.json and bun.lock because the repository declares npm as packageManager; update lock only with scripts disabled. Allowed dependency metadata paths for this task now include package-lock.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.

Provider-boundary refactor integrated in two reviewed checkpoints: 85f9604d (capability negotiation, semantic App adapters, recoverable failure disposition and unknown-outcome fencing) and 2125ddda (provider-neutral typed snapshot backend, exact optional agent-device@0.20.2 dependency, Node/runtime/version identity gates, CLI fallback evidence and release hardening). Upstream agent-device source and current Xcode 27 devicectl help were compared; the terminate contract is valid, so no speculative fork was introduced. The proven upstream typed-client limitation is lack of public AbortSignal, therefore mutations deliberately remain on the cancellable CLI path. Live phone latency belongs to T3 and is not claimed here.
Provider 边界重构已在 85f9604d 和 2125ddda 集成并通过聚焦验证。作为已交付基础关闭；剩余实机延迟和 JD 正确性不属于此技术步骤。

tasks.title: Separate physical iOS resource ownership from automation engine identity
tasks.objective: Keep ios-device as the shared physical-iPhone ownership and mutual-exclusion domain while adding a backward-compatible explicit automation-engine identity to InteractionSession records and evidence. New agent-device sessions must declare the agent-device engine; CoreDevice/WDA sessions must declare the coredevice engine. Replace interaction-id/reason heuristics with engine-aware validation plus bounded legacy compatibility, ensure actions cannot consume another engine's session, and prove that active sessions from either engine block the other on the same target. Preserve all public action IDs and do not require a connected phone.
acceptanceCriteria: ios-device remains the shared resource domain for the same physical iPhone across CoreDevice and agent-device.
Every newly created physical iOS interaction records an explicit automation engine.
Agent-device actions fail closed on CoreDevice-owned sessions and CoreDevice actions fail closed on agent-device-owned sessions.
Legacy schemaVersion 1 interaction records remain readable through narrowly bounded inference.
Cross-engine open attempts on the same target are rejected before app launch or UI mutation.
Focused provider tests and all declared checks pass.

tasks.title: Defer Task verification on repository check lease conflicts
tasks.objective: Fix verify_task so repository-wide Process Runtime lease contention is classified as deferred infrastructure coordination rather than failed source verification. A PROCESS_LEASE_CONFLICT must return before recordTaskVerification, preserve the Task's current lifecycle and existing acceptance evidence, expose the conflicting process and a deterministic fresh retry_request_id, and allow a later quiet-window retry without reusing the terminal failed Process. Real completed check failures remain authoritative.
acceptanceCriteria: PROCESS_LEASE_CONFLICT returns verification_deferred and does not call recordTaskVerification.
The response exposes a bounded conflicting process reference and a deterministic fresh retry_request_id.
Retrying with the returned request ID creates a fresh check Process instead of reusing the terminal conflicted Process.
Task status and prior verification/acceptance evidence remain unchanged on deferred verification.
A real nonzero check result still records failed verification and requests changes.
Focused MCP Controller regression, type, MCP compatibility and Controller V8 checks pass.
notes: 这是旧 Task 验证生命周期缺陷，不属于物理 iPhone 用户需求。由 ISS-20260802-7E1D69 的 Work-only 执行合同和需求完成语义统一替代。

tasks.title: Close live JD correctness and warm-path latency regressions
tasks.objective: Use the 2026-08-01 JD real-device transcript as primary evidence. In an isolated checkout, reproduce and fix the remaining Repo Harness defects: compile the JD semantic adapter as focus/navigate -> resolve real editable control -> fill -> submit instead of filling the home-page proxy; preserve healthy sessions for selector/ref/type/semantic failures and destroy only classified transport/runner/unknown-outcome failures; make page-transition diffs and ref generations safe so a contradictory zero-diff cannot authorize stale refs; carry the resolved Apple signing context through every lazy Runner start in an interaction; and replace repeated full plugin manifest/action-schema payloads on normal plugin_action_execute responses with a bounded compact receipt plus an explicit detail path. Then add a warm multi-step execution primitive or adapter batch that performs known semantic steps without returning to the model after every action, with phase timings and bounded evidence. Keep public action IDs and sensitive-action policy unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: JD search adapter follows the actual two-page control flow and passes fixture coverage for home proxy and real editable input.
Recoverable semantic action failures leave the interaction active; proven Runner/transport/unknown-outcome failures still close or fence it.
Contradictory or incomplete diffs invalidate refs and trigger one bounded fresh snapshot before mutation.
The Team, runner bundle and developer directory resolved at open/prepare are reused by lazy XCTest startup.
Normal plugin action responses do not repeat the complete plugin manifest and all action schemas; full detail remains explicitly retrievable.
A known JD search can execute as one bounded warm semantic operation after session open, returning one final receipt with phase timings rather than requiring model analysis after each primitive.
Focused fixture/fault/property regressions and all declared checks pass.
notes: 真实 JD 正确性和热路径仍是用户需求，但必须等新 Runtime 与需求/Work 架构切换后，按剩余验收差距创建新的 Work；旧 destructive Task 不再直接调度。
